name: vintage-hollywood-red-fur-glamour
image_vibe: Dreamy old-Hollywood glamour, deep crimson satin, soft-focus film halation
image_purpose: Create a luxurious 4:5 vintage glamour portrait with cinematic negative space.

prompt.project_info: A cinematic vintage glamour portrait in a dark studio with a deep red backdrop gradient.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with a short-to-medium wavy vintage bob, classic glam makeup, natural luminous skin, and a relaxed elegant gaze. She wears a deep red satin or velvet slip gown with thin straps and a fitted bodice, plus a white faux-fur stole with long fluffy fibers draped from the shoulders, and holds a small dark clutch.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 vertical 3/4-body fashion portrait, subject slightly off-center, shoulders angled and head tilted back slightly, hands near the waist, generous negative space to the right, deep red backdrop, subtle light streaks and lens flares.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused key light from upper left, subtle rim light separating fur from background, practical streaks, gentle specular highlights on satin, controlled shadows, and tasteful dreamy halation.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens, f/1.6, eyes and lips sharp, detailed fur texture, softly blooming edges, fine film grain, warm natural skin texture, gentle vignette, medium contrast and controlled saturation.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 cinematic vintage-Hollywood glamour portrait of an adult woman in a dark studio with a deep red backdrop gradient, subtle light streaks, and cinematic negative space. Give her a short-to-medium wavy vintage bob, classic glam makeup, natural luminous skin, and a relaxed elegant gaze. She wears a deep red satin or velvet slip gown with thin straps and a fitted bodice, with a white faux-fur stole draped from her shoulders, delicate necklace, subtle earrings, and a small dark clutch. Frame a 3/4-body pose slightly off-center with generous negative space to the right. Use an 85mm lens at f/1.6, soft diffused upper-left key, subtle rim light, gentle satin highlights, tasteful halation, fine analog grain, warm natural skin texture, and a soft vignette.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent gown, exposed underwear, nudity, fetish framing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: source old-Hollywood glamour reference
assets.usage: Use only for red gown, white faux-fur stole, studio composition, lighting, and film treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the red gown, white faux-fur stole, 4:5 glamour framing, deep red studio, and soft halation. Keep the adult subject original and gown coverage secure; accessories and light streaks may vary.

changes: Clarified adult subject and secure gown coverage.
Replaced sensual wording with elegant glamour direction while preserving the old-Hollywood concept.
